answer: Random peer audit makes fakes costly. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond to join. When a gale of new accounts blows in, a beacon audits 5% and three random peers re-run their work on a public terrace. A failed audit slashes the bond. An attacker with 100 fakes locks 4,000 POA and loses 200/epoch, 5 caught; failure leaves a pigment stain fading only after 20 clean epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once, passes audits, earns fees, keeps rewards whole.
